verdict.rationale: SumUp's Cloud API documents pairing multiple Solo readers to an account and naming each reader, which covers the reader-registration half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows an API or MCP tool for creating a location or store, so end-to-end location provisioning by an agent is not shown. The 'manage multiple stores' line is a back-office POS feature, not an API capability, so it earns no credit. missing for 10: API endpoint to create a location/store, evidence that reader pairing is exposed as an API call an agent can make, MCP/agent-toolkit tools covering reader or location provisioning, an end-to-end provisioning walkthrough, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent provision a new location end-to-end via API — creating the location and registering its readers
